eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Jefferson, OR; at 8:13 PM on JUL 25, 2026 Effective until 11:13 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Wildfire Alert from Jefferson County Sheriff's Office: The evacuation level for The western side of the following zones: NW 10 and 9 on the eastern side of NW Deschutes Drive has been upgraded from Level 2 to a Level 3- GO NOW! Evacuate Immediately. There is significant danger in your area. If you need evacuation assistance call 5413842080.
